explosionoverhaul.configuration.title: Explosion Overhaul Configs
explosionoverhaul.configuration.launchFa: Whether to launch falling blocks after an explosion
explosionoverhaul.configuration.launchBl: Chance to launch a given block during an explosion
explosionoverhaul.configuration.blockDef: Whether to use default explosion knockback for launched falling blocks
explosionoverhaul.configuration.blockKno: Amount the blocks are launched when using custom knockback
explosionoverhaul.configuration.randomDi: Amount the direction blocks are launched is randomised
explosionoverhaul.configuration.directio: Amount the direction is biased upwards when launching blocks
explosionoverhaul.configuration.enableSm: Whether exploded blocks should have smoke trails
explosionoverhaul.configuration.smokePar: Chance for a smoking block to emit a trail particle
How fast smoke particles spread out from their original position
explosionoverhaul.configuration.enableFu: Whether primed tnt should emit sparks
explosionoverhaul.configuration.fuseSpar: How fast fuse particles spread out from their original position
explosionoverhaul.configuration.rePlaceT: Whether to use custom logic to attempt to re place blocks in update on land tag
